kev_metadata.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability

title: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) dynamic link library (DLL) contains a side loading vulnerability due to it improperly validating input before loading libraries. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office OLE DLL Side Loading Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Office OLE DLL Side Loading Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Use-After-Free Vulnerability

title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Use-After-Free Vulnerability

affected.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense

kev_metadata.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense
kev_metadata.requiredAction: The KEV due date refers to the deadline by which FCEB agencies are expected to review and begin implementing the guidance outlined in Emergency Directive (ED) 25-03 (URL listed below in Notes). Agencies must follow the mitigation steps provided by CISA (URL listed below in Notes) and vendor’s instructions (URL listed below in Notes). Adhere to the applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are not available.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Web Server contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-20362.

title: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

kev_metadata.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://www.sudo.ws/security/advisories/chroot_bug/ ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-32463
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability

title: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
